subject: Emily Lazzaro City Council Candidacy
overview: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan interviewed City Council candidate Emily Lazzaro regarding her platform and professional background. Lazzaro emphasized her priorities of increasing city revenue, improving school funding, and expanding municipal social services for housing and addiction.

items.title: Favorite Medford Eateries
items.summary: Lazzaro discussed her favorite local restaurants and commented on the positive economic impact the Chevalier Theatre has on Medford Square businesses.

items.title: Background and Motivation for Council Run
items.summary: The candidate described her professional history in state government and the Medford school department, explaining her choice to run for City Council to better advocate for school funding.

items.title: Social Service Priorities
items.summary: Lazzaro advocated for Medford to establish robust municipal support services for addiction and housing security, citing her work with the Malden Warming Center as a potential model.

items.title: Revenue Generation and Public Institutions
items.summary: The candidate discussed the need to prioritize new revenue streams to address local income inequality and provide stable funding for the library and school systems.

items.title: Personal Background and Community Life
items.summary: Lazzaro shared her experiences as a parent, runner, and writer, and detailed her former career as a theater professional and actor.
